verifications.detail: Sourcey docs built and deployed to GitHub Pages at https://codeboost-tr.github.io/dayjs/
10 markdown pages covering full Day.js API surface: introduction, installation, parsing, get/set, manipulating, displaying, querying, formatting, plugins, i18n
Sourcey build produces search-enabled static site with OG images, sitemap, LLM-ready output
All API examples verified against Day.js v1.11.21 behavior; code samples are accurate and tested
Delivery uses public upstream data only (iamkun/dayjs public repo), no forks or private repos modified
Run 'npm install sourcey && npx sourcey build' in docs/sourcey/ directory to reproduce
